info.title: Spain Legal by Legal Fournier Agent API
info.description: Spain legal screening and published Legal Fournier article/video retrieval, with official-source guidance and explicit-consent contact requests. Screening is preliminary; contact requests require explicit user consent. Use canonical citation URLs from search/fetch. Do not send identity documents or passport numbers.
